control.about: One seeded flaky test per root cause (benchmark/control). NETWORK is left out: a test that calls the internet would make the benchmark itself flaky.

dev.flakehunter.control.PriceLookupTest#.why: Reads a cache that only CacheWarmupTest fills, so it passes only when that class ran first.

dev.flakehunter.control.AmountFormatTest.why: LocaleSwitchTest sets the default locale to German and never restores it; afterwards 1.5 prints as 1,50.

dev.flakehunter.control.ReportDateTest#p.why: Expects the epoch as midnight, which holds only in UTC; fails under the TIMEZONE strategy.

dev.flakehunter.control.VisitCounterTest.why: Unsynchronized read-modify-write from two threads loses an update when a save is slow.

dev.flakehunter.control.EmailSenderTest#.why: Sleeps a fixed 50 ms for background work that takes 20 to 70 ms instead of waiting for it.

dev.flakehunter.control.TeamDraftTest#fi.why: An unseeded shuffle leaves both captains out of the first team about 1 time in 6.

dev.flakehunter.control.TagListTest#list.why: Assumes a HashSet keeps insertion order; the order follows identity hashes, which change with allocation history.

dev.flakehunter.control.ExportLockTest#t.why: ImportJobTest creates the same lock file in the temp directory and never deletes it.

alsoFlaky.dev.flakehunter.control.CacheWarmupTest#: Races PriceLookupTest on an unsynchronized HashMap under PARALLEL (rare).
alsoFlaky.dev.flakehunter.control.ImportJobTest#ru: ExportLockTest deletes the shared lock file while it runs under PARALLEL.

fastjson.about: Real flaky tests from IDoFT, reproduced by benchmark/hunt.py (benchmark/targets.md).

com.alibaba.json.bvt.serializer.date.Dat.why: DateTest.setUp sets the global JSON.defaultTimeZone and defaultLocale and never resets them (fixed upstream in PR 2148).
